newsitem.title: FRANCE: Steel, arms workers to march in Paris on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Steel, arms workers to march in Paris on Saturday.

text.p: French steelworkers and employees of state armsmaking firms will march through Paris on Saturday to protest against planned lay-offs in the defence industry, the Communist-led CGT trades union group said on Thursday.
A union statement said the government's decision to reorganise defence industries would result in tens of thousands of lost jobs and "social and economic disasters in many regions."
The defence industry restructuring, aimed at reducing military spending, would also affect civilian sectors such as research and the aircraft and electronics industries, the statement said.

On Wednesday, the country's main teachers' unions joined other labour groups in calling for a nationwide strike on October 17 to protest against government austerity plans aimed at helping France qualify for European monetary union from 1999.
